# Bug report

The test suite in this repository fails.

```
$ python -m pytest tests/ -q
F                                                                        [100%]
=================================== FAILURES ===================================
__________________________ test_expiry_at_exactly_ttl __________________________
    def test_expiry_at_exactly_ttl():
        c = Clock()
        cache = TTLCache(2, 10.0, c)
        cache.put("a", 1)
        c.t = 10.0
>       assert cache.get("a") is None
E       AssertionError: assert 1 is None
E        +  where 1 = get('a')
E        +    where get = <solution.core.TTLCache object at 0x...>.get
tests/test_public.py:14: AssertionError
=========================== short test summary info ============================
FAILED tests/test_public.py::test_expiry_at_exactly_ttl - AssertionError: ass...
1 failed in <duration>
```

Fix the source so that the suite passes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
- Do not add new dependencies; the standard library is all that is available.
- Keep the public API of the `solution` package unchanged: `TTLCache`.
diff:
diff -ruN -x __pycache__ -x .pytest_cache -x issue.md -x '*.pyc' /home/user/experiments/temporal-routing-headroom/tasks/lru_ttl/repo/solution/core.py /home/user/runs/jev/haiku_r6/lru_ttl/solution/core.py
--- /home/user/experiments/temporal-routing-headroom/tasks/lru_ttl/repo/solution/core.py	2026-11-07 17:34:52.326620089 +0000
+++ /home/user/runs/jev/haiku_r6/lru_ttl/solution/core.py	2026-11-08 01:48:36.249079928 +0000
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@
         self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, inserted_at); end = MRU
 
     def _expired(self, ts) -> bool:
-        return self.clock() - ts > self.ttl
+        return self.clock() - ts >= self.ttl
 
     def _purge(self):
         dead = [k for k, (_, ts) in self._data.items() if self._expired(ts)]
summary: The visible suite now passes. I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: the `_expired` method compared age with `>`, so an entry whose age was exactly the TTL was still returned by `get`. I changed it to `>=`, which makes an entry expire at exactly TTL, as the test expects. `_expired` is used by `get`, `put` and `_purge`, so all three now treat an entry at exactly TTL as expired. Nothing under `tests/` was touched, no dependencies were added, and the `TTLCache` public API is unchanged. I did not run the hidden suite, so the boundary behaviour for other cases is untested beyond this one assertion.
